method: WP-7.1 fleet reproducibility sweep: the EARLIEST known commit whose build reproduces the deployed runtime bytecode — the point at which that exact source closure was introduced.
caveat: This commit reproduces the deployed bytecode; it is not proof it is the commit that was deployed. LI.FI deploys before merging the PR, so the commit carrying the deployed source often lands days AFTER the deploy — see daysAfterDeploy. Bounded by the commits actually built: an earlier one may exist.
